name: nlpie-research/umls-to-snomed-icd10cm-mapper
description: UMLS to SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM mapping tool: A Python script for generating JSON files containing mappings between UMLS CUIs and SNOMED CT or ICD-10-CM codes using the UMLS Metathesaurus. Supports exact match, broad relations, and parent-child hierarchy mapping methods.
score_rationale: Targeted terminology mapping utility for UMLS, SNOMED CT, and ICD-10-CM with direct relevance to terminology crosswalks.
category: Health Data Standards, Terminologies, Ontologies & Vocabulary Tooling
